subject: Point the README showcase section to the live site
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-05 to fix the README before the engine is published in DigitalEarthSwedenExperimentalLab, in the lab copy and here. The Showcase section lists four old tabs with wrong place names (Lysekil, Västervik; correct are Hunnebostrand and Munkarp). Replace the table with a short pointer to tobiasedman.github.io/imintengine and digitalearth.se/case. Not in scope: the sibling imint-showcase sentence and the clone URL, which are correct for this repository. Review: Codex or owner.
